#!name=Sub-Store
#!desc=Optional subscription manager; manual synchronization only. No scheduled task.
#!category=订阅管理

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% sub.store

[Script]
# 主程序 已经去掉 Sub-Store Core 的参数 [,ability=http-client-policy] 不会爆内存，这个参数在 Surge 非常占用内存； 如果不需要使用指定节点功能 例如[加旗帜脚本或者cname脚本] 则可以使用此脚本
Sub-Store Core=type=http-request,pattern=^https?:\/\/sub\.store\/((download)|api\/(preview|sync|(utils\/node-info))),script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sub-store-org/Sub-Store/d26e713e38901e02565a6505c1ae5cb8bb8a1a22/sub-store-1.min.js,requires-body=true,max-size=-1,timeout=900
Sub-Store Simple=type=http-request,pattern=^https?:\/\/sub\.store(?=\/|$),script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sub-store-org/Sub-Store/d26e713e38901e02565a6505c1ae5cb8bb8a1a22/sub-store-0.min.js,requires-body=true,max-size=-1,timeout=900
